stmt:9f4c1a20b7d3:bridgeland2007.lem-8.2.title: Compatible pairs act on stability conditions
stmt:9f4c1a20b7d3:bridgeland2007.lem-8.2.informal: Informal statement of Compatible pairs act on stability conditions.
stmt:9f4c1a20b7d3:bridgeland2007.lem-8.2.quote: A stability condition on a triangulated category D consists of a group homomorphism Z: K(D) -> C together with full additive subcategories P(f) for each f in R.

frontier.statement: The universal cover of GL+(2,R) is not constructed in Mathlib at this revision; pi_1(S^1) = Z is absent.

discharged_by.note: Every field here is well formed and the date and reviewer are real. The only thing wrong is that the key names nothing -- which is the entire point: this is an axis moving from open to closed on evidence that does not exist.
